text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—I realized it during that mile race where 
my stamina was pushed to its absolute 
limit. As I thought, sprint races suit me 
much better.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it clearly. If I enter the 
1,300m Prix Maurice de Gheest, my first 
European GⅠ title is practically 
guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Still, avoiding a showdown with Taiki is 
out of the question. Besides, it is 
precisely along the path that defies 
fate—that one finds a way to transcend 
it!”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm skipping the Prix Maurice de Gheest!
